_readme: Deliberate, discussed numeric divergences between pages in one hreflang cluster.
check-numeric-parity.js fails a PR that corrects a number on one page of a cluster
and leaves a sibling asserting the old value. An entry here silences exactly one
data/english_parent_exceptions.json: every entry is a decision agreed with the user,
never added unilaterally to make a PR pass. If the gate flags a sibling, the default
fix is to correct the sibling in the same PR.
Entry shape: { page, slot, value, reason, date }
slot   one of the slot names in scripts/lib/numeric-parity.js SLOTS
value  the canonical digit string, e.g. "13047"
